wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 708162767 supplies the overall church extent and the southeast front facing the square. The mapped site node and official description identify the original Santuário Velho.
lodDetails: Four levels retain both spires, the blue framed façade, clock gable and nave. Closer levels add louvres, clock markings, door fanlight and roof seams.
limitations: This is the August 2024 blue and white appearance of the old parish church. Tower heights, roof cladding, side and rear windows, and the clock dial and entrance detail are estimates.
The independent public elevation field is preserved. The low foundation, steps and exterior ground contact are approximate.
